Drop the files here. Treadmill: the COSMED export is enough, because it holds the speed. If a session was recorded as several COSMED files, add them all and they are joined by their clock times. Cycling: the COSMED export, plus the Lode export if you saved it. Without a Lode file, you can enter the power steps on the next screen. You can add a heart-rate file (Polar or Garmin CSV, TCX or GPX) if the COSMED did not record heart rate.

    Everything runs in this browser and works offline. No data leave this computer.
